pins.definition: A liquid extracted from fruits or plants.
The liquid pressed from fruit or vegetables, drunk as a beverage.
A drink made from the liquid of fruits or vegetables.

situation: A person at a breakfast counter on a sunny morning pours a heavy stream of bright orange liquid from a glass pitcher into a tall tumbler.
subject: the pressed fruit liquid
